moments.title: The Hundred Continues This Weekend
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues its group stage with multiple men's and women's matches across the UK this weekend, including Birmingham Phoenix vs Welsh Fire and London Spirit vs Southern Brave today, and Trent Rockets vs Sunrisers Leeds tomorrow.

angles.name: Weekend Cricket Action
angles.copy: Catch the action this weekend in The Hundred! Today sees Birmingham Phoenix face Welsh Fire, and London Spirit take on Southern Brave. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire in Action
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are in action today in The Hundred! Can they heat up the competition against Birmingham Phoenix? Keep up with all the scores!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Break Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender, 32, and Olivia Dean, 27, have made UK chart history as their duet 'Rein Me In' becomes the longest-running Official UK Number 1 single ever, hitting 19 weeks at the top and surpassing a 73-year record.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever, with an incredible 19 weeks at the top! What a tune.

angles.name: Sam & Olivia's Reign
angles.copy: 19 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender (32) and Olivia Dean (27) have smashed a 73-year record with 'Rein Me In'. Is it your favourite Number 1 of all time?

angles.name: Chart Talk
angles.copy: Beyond 'Rein Me In': Shakira and Burna Boy's World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' is holding strong at No. 2, and Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' climbs to No. 3. What's your pick for next week's top spot?
